'''Cat Caller''' is a {{type|Cat}} enemy.

== Behavior ==
Melee attacker that keeps distance and casts Cat Call. Counter attacks melee attackers. If there are no damage-dealing allies left, it will run.

=== Abilities ===
; Basic attack - {{a|Melee Attack}}
: Deals {{icon|Physical Damage}}, scales with {{stat|STR}}.

; Cat Call
: Inflicts {{st|Slow|#=2}} on a unit up to 6 tiles away.

=== Tips ===
* Cat Caller should usually be a low priority target, as it does not deal damage and the player can work around the {{st|Slow}} debuff without any long-term consequences, unlike enemies that deal damage.
** Additionally, they will run away once other enemies are killed.
* Cat Callers usually spawn alone or in pairs, at the edges of the map. Prioritizing movement spells can help reach them even with the slows.

== Trivia ==
* Its design seems to be similar to the concept of a human cat caller, that is, someone who makes inappropriate comments about others, often sexual in nature.
* [[Cat Caller]] look and behave similar to [[Siren]].
* They use a female4 [[voice]] for cats, voiced by Lisa Kuras.
